ownership.quote: this year, Azure surpassed $75 billion in revenue, up 34 percent, driven by growth across all workloads

stage.note: Azure GPU VMs (the ND/NC/NV GPU-accelerated Virtual Machines families) are a product line within Azure, itself a business line of publicly traded Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT); not independently funded.

revenue.basis: Whole-company Microsoft Corporation revenue from its official FY2025 Q4/full-year earnings press release; Azure itself is reported as a segment component (surpassed $75B, up 34%), and GPU VMs specifically are not broken out as a standalone audited figure.

note: Azure GPU VMs (ND/NC/NV series) are a cloud GPU compute product of Microsoft Azure, part of Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT), a public company — not an independent startup. No separate funding/accelerator history applies. FY2025 (ended June 30, 2025) total Microsoft revenue was $281.7B (confirmed, company press release); Microsoft separately stated Azure alone surpassed $75B in revenue for the year, up 34%, but did not disclose an exact audited Azure-only or GPU-VM-only dollar figure.
